rules.label: Financial Assistance - Medically Required Services
rules.quote: We offer financial assistance for services that are medically required.

rules.label: Financial Assistance - Location Restriction
rules.quote: We offer financial assistance only for health care services received at one of our locations.

application.quote: You have up to 240 days after the date of your initial patient responsibility statement to apply.

payment_plan.quote: Start a payment plan arrangement with National Jewish Health. This will help you manage your account while your application is processed.

notes: Eligibility based on insurance coverage, income, family size, assets, and other issues, using Federal Poverty Level guidelines (Schedule 1).

Financial assistance may help pay for co-insurance and deductible amounts, but does not apply to co-payment amounts for physician services or patient balance amounts required by Medicaid or other need-based programs.
Financial assistance is not available when your insurance plan denies access to National Jewish Health.
Applications may require copies of tax returns, bank statements and pay stubs.
Complete applications receive a response within 20 business days.
If you do not make payments and do not contact us about payments, we may use a collection agency.
AGB applies: If you qualify for financial assistance, you cannot be charged more than the amounts generally billed (see Schedule 3).
rule_fap_general may leave out a condition: policy requires services to be received at one of their locations
rule_fap_location may leave out a condition: policy requires services to be medically required
